results.manifest_excerpt:
schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

## Install Packages --------------------------------------------------
[install]
nodejs_20.pkg-path = "nodejs_20"
postgresql_16.pkg-path = "postgresql_16"


## Environment Variables ---------------------------------------------
[vars]
PGHOST = "127.0.0.1"
PGPORT = "5432"
PGUSER = "postgres"
PGDATABASE = "myapp_dev"


## Activation Hook ---------------------------------------------------
[hook]
on-activate = """
  # Node: install dependencies if missing or lockfile changed
  if [ ! -d node_modules ] || { [ -f package-lock.json ] && [ package-lock.json -nt node_modules ]; }; then
    npm install --silent
  fi

  # PostgreSQL: one-time cluster init in the project-local cache
  export PGDATA="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/postgres"
  if [ ! -d "$PGDATA" ]; then
    initdb -D "$PGDATA" \
      --username="$PGUSER" \
      --auth=trust \
      --no-locale \
      --encoding=UTF8 >&2
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -o "-p $PGPORT -k /tmp" \
      -l "$PGDATA/init.log" start
    until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -q; do sleep 0.2; done
    createdb -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT" -U "$PGUSER" "$PGDATABASE"
    pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" stop -m fast
  fi
"""


## Services ---------------------------------------------------------
[services.postgres]
command = """
  exec postgres \
    -D "$PGDATA" \
    -p "$PGPORT" \
    -k /tmp \
    -c listen_addresses="$PGHOST"
"""


## Other Environment Options -----------------------------------------
[options]
systems = [
  "aarch64-darwin",
  "aarch64-linux",
  "x86_64-darwin",
  "x86_64-linux",
]
